summary: Max Verstappen converted pole position into his maiden Singapore Grand Prix victory, capitalizing on George Russell's crash from the lead in the sprint to establish early momentum in the main race. Hamilton's strategical miscalculation during the Grand Prix left Ferrari's Kimi Antonelli within striking distance of the world championship, with the title now within his grasp at the next round in Austin. Verstappen's resurgence has propelled Red Bull back into contention while McLaren's troubled weekend in Singapore has handed the championship narrative a dramatic shift in Antonelli's favor.
